criteria.question: does a signed spiking simulation reproduce the excitatory pC1 song phenotypes that static connectivity could not explain?
criteria.source: Current Biology 36:4697-4716 (2026), Fig. 5 (pC1/pC1x song phenotypes); pMP2 pulse, DNp13 sine, pIP10 both

groups.pC1_15_16: pC1_15a, pC1_15b, pC1_15c and every pC1_16 subtype present

protocol.null: degree-preserving rewired null (flycns/graph.py rewire_null, seed 0; mode FLYCNS_NULL, default global), pC1_14a at 100 Hz
protocol.model: declared parameter set (LIFParams), electrical synapses on

P1_pc1_14a_pulse_over_sine.rule: conjunction, pC1_14a at 100 Hz: (a) pMP2 spikes/cell/pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval at or above 0.5; (b) pMP2 minus DNp13 paired per pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval above 0, UNRESOLVED (not scorable) if DNp13 fires in no pulse of any group and rate on the real network; PASS only if both parts pass

P2_pc1_13_14_pulse_over_sine.rule: conjunction, pC1_13_14 at 100 Hz: (a) pMP2 spikes/cell/pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval at or above 0.5; (b) pMP2 minus DNp13 paired per pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval above 0, UNRESOLVED (not scorable) if DNp13 fires in no pulse of any group and rate on the real network; PASS only if both parts pass

P3_14a_exceeds_15_16_on_pulse.rule: pMP2 under pC1_14a minus under pC1_15_16, both at 100 Hz: two separate simulations, each resampled over its own pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies above 0

P4_null_silent.rule: pMP2 under pC1_14a at 100 Hz on the rewired null, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies at or below 0.1 spikes/cell/pulse

criteria.limit: suppression phenotypes untestable: no background activity

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 10 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020

supersedes.why: model refrozen: the JON -> GF compound potential is calibrated per giant fiber on its own coupled afferents (run 12 measured 3.65 and 0.73 mV for a 3 mV target); w_scale 0.3 -> 0.4, the value the registered benchmark-blind rule selects (fit/select_wscale.py); the giant fiber adaptation refit under both (benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py). Criteria unchanged.
